approval_scope: One approval for all 14 added DMS-20 MLX decision candidate rows, bound to shared corpus and protocol, exact model and tokenizer revisions, runner/runtime locks, input policy, and resource floors.
approval_source: Explicit active user goal: complete the added DMS-20 evaluations.
artifact_download_policy: Only the exact revision-pinned artifact files listed per row; do not retain model weights after each row is evaluated.

host_preflight.resource_gate: Repeat immediately before each stage/load; abort if row floors are no longer met.

protocol.categories: seven shared, licensed DMS-20 transfer categories
protocol.input_order: canonical and all-options-reversed; identical option IDs and gold labels
protocol.input_policy: Use the frozen 3,584-token normalized-content limit with 512 tokens reserved for model formatting. Count with each candidate tokenizer before inference; mark over-limit predictions incorrect and do not send truncated text.
protocol.paired_bootstrap_strata: source category; identical item IDs across candidates
protocol.primary_metric: equal macro average of accuracy across the seven included source categories
protocol.probability_metrics: raw Brier and top-label ECE; no calibration fitting
protocol.sensitivity_order: reverse all options while preserving option IDs and gold labels

result_policy: Local noncommercial comparative research only. Preserve existing DMS-20 matrices and results. No production admission or context-management claim.
